value.rationale: Scalar affine Alexander quandles form a natural ubiquitous finite algebraic family. The finding determines the complete unrestricted-depth FO^3 quotient, not merely a small example or a routine special case, with twelve labeled classes, precise minimum representatives and a sharp global order-nine ceiling. The split of three harmonic cases and the explicit four-variable separator show genuinely different expressive power that cannot be read from finite isomorphism tables. It supplies a reusable boundary benchmark for finite-variable logic on algebraic incidence relations.
